directions.failure_rule: Any increasing paired gain, no strict decrease, positive zero-external control, censored exact baseline or failed certificate rejects the hypothesis.
directions.gap: Map paired fee response and negative controls under the existing terminal-suffix model.
directions.hypothesis: For the registered seeds, raising fee from 0 to 2 to 4 weakly reduces exact gain over no-action with external reward 6, strictly for at least one seed; zero-external controls have no positive gain.
directions.information_boundary: Only public tasks, prescribed private beliefs, training-only reservations and past permitted observations enter decisions. Realized synthetic outcomes/costs are accessed only after allocation freezes.
directions.overlap: External incentives and decision-market manipulation are established. Fee effects already occur in DEVIATION #25. This is a small new grid diagnostic, not novelty.
directions.title: Do transaction fees suppress finite outside-incentive attack gains?

directions.failure_rule: Any unsound interval, weaker endpoint bound, no strict improvement or censored exact baseline rejects the hypothesis.
directions.gap: Run independently checked paired bound ablations on a different tiny development grid; no speed claim.
directions.hypothesis: Endpoint root bounds are never looser than the fallback and strictly tighter for at least one registered game; every full interval covers independent exact utility.
directions.information_boundary: Only public tasks, prescribed private beliefs, training-only reservations and past permitted observations enter decisions. Realized synthetic outcomes/costs are accessed only after allocation freezes.
directions.overlap: Branch-and-bound and stronger relaxations are well known. DEVIATION #23/#25 already implement and measure this. This run is a scoped reproduction/ablation.
directions.title: Does endpoint relaxation tighten finite-game certificates?

directions.failure_rule: Negative shared-perturbation mean or a smaller difference than independent perturbations rejects the hypothesis; any budget violation invalidates the run.
directions.gap: Probe whether an existing hypothesis survives matched budget and signal controls, including participation/subsidy accounting.
directions.hypothesis: Mean paired pool-minus-LMSR realized proxy is nonnegative under shared perturbations and at least its independent-perturbation value on the registered synthetic tasks.
directions.information_boundary: Only public tasks, prescribed private beliefs, training-only reservations and past permitted observations enter decisions. Realized synthetic outcomes/costs are accessed only after allocation freezes.
directions.overlap: Simple averaging and forecast correlation effects are established. DEVIATION RESEARCH H2 already anticipates this. No new mechanism or empirical-market superiority claim.
directions.title: Does simple pooling match the market under correlated forecast errors?
